title: Recover gracefully from malformed Ollama NDJSON stream lines
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 10.5. Per-line JSON parse failures in streaming should not hard-fail the entire assistant turn. Add resilient parse handling, preserve accumulated content, and emit diagnostics for malformed chunks.
